title: DevWorkWire
description: Workflow CLI: Markdown epics and stories to validated, duplicate-free Jira backlogs. Agent-ready.
problem: Work planned in documents gets re-typed into the tracker by hand, creating duplicates and lost acceptance criteria.
built: A Typer CLI that parses and validates Markdown work items, previews create/skip actions, imports into Jira idempotently, and exposes a stable JSON contract plus a portable AI-agent skill.
role: Creator and maintainer: architecture, implementation, and documentation.
decisions: Clean Architecture with a WorkItemProvider port so the tracker is swappable; local import state for safe resumption; explicit --yes for agent-driven writes.

title: Open Projects Hub
description: AI-assisted platform that turns raw requirements into reviewable user stories and backlogs.
problem: Client requirements arrive vague, and turning them into testable user stories is slow and rarely reviewed.
built: A FastAPI + React platform where an LLM drafts BDD user stories from raw input, a human approves them, and clients review approved stories read-only with an access code.
role: Creator and maintainer: product definition, architecture, backend, frontend, and automated quality gates.
decisions: Clean Architecture/DDD with one bounded context per feature; encrypted per-user LLM keys; no persisted AI drafts; 20 ADRs documenting the trade-offs.

title: AI Engineer Setup
description: Portable skills, agents, and instructions for Claude Code, Codex, opencode, and Copilot CLI.
problem: Each AI coding tool needs its own configuration, so standards drift between tools and machines.
built: A single repository of shared instructions, skills, agents, and commands, with install and verify scripts that link them into each harness and check parity.
decisions: Canonical shared sources with harness adapters; symlink-based install with backups; verification that every agent and command exists for every supported tool.

title: Orthopedic Spine Clinic Platform
description: Client project: clinic website with online booking and an admin dashboard, on a FastAPI backend.
problem: A physiotherapy clinic needed a public web presence plus an internal way to manage appointments, patients, and testimonials.
built: A React site with services, testimonials, contact, and appointment booking, plus an authenticated admin area, backed by a FastAPI + PostgreSQL API with JWT auth and Alembic migrations.
role: Freelance engineer at NaranjoSolutions: design, frontend, backend, and deployment.
decisions: Feature-based React structure; REST API with Pydantic validation; Dockerized services; frontend deployed on Vercel. Client repositories are private.

title: Template Docs
description: Docusaurus documentation template with auto-generated sidebars, GitHub Pages deployment, and AI-guided section authoring.
longDescription: A starter template for project documentation built with Docusaurus. Ships with section scaffolding for context, requirements, planning, architecture, decisions, and prototypes, plus Claude Code, opencode, and GitHub Copilot integrations that populate each section through guided interviews.

title: Story Flow Engine
description: Clean Architecture reference CLI that turns Markdown epics and stories into Jira issues.
longDescription: A Python CLI with Typer and InquirerPy that parses structured Markdown epics and user stories and creates them in Jira through a ports-and-adapters design. DevWorkWire is its actively developed successor.

title: EndToEndLabCR Documentation
description: Comprehensive tech documentation platform for knowledge transfer and learning, built with Markdown and modern static site generation.
longDescription: A complete documentation platform serving as a knowledge base for EndToEndLabCR's educational initiatives. Covers web development, software engineering best practices, and hands-on tutorials for knowledge transfer sessions.

title: KT Session Templates
description: Starter templates and boilerplate projects for Knowledge Transfer sessions covering React, TypeScript, and modern web development.
longDescription: A collection of starter templates designed for EndToEndLabCR's Knowledge Transfer sessions. Each template provides a solid foundation for learning specific technologies with progressive complexity and real-world examples.

title: NaranjoSolutions
description: Freelance and consulting practice: web applications, backend APIs, automation, and DevOps for clients.
longDescription: NaranjoSolutions delivers full-cycle client projects, from React frontends and FastAPI backends to Docker, GitHub Actions, and AWS delivery. Client repositories are private for confidentiality.
